explanation: It fires only at D1 of the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 onward), and only when the previous trial was a rare transition where the agent chose a2 but reached S1, at roughly 8-10 whether or not that trial was rewarded (about 4 if it fires around trial 93). Every other step is 0: all GO and D2 steps, D1 after common transitions or after a1 rare transitions, and any trial before about 93.
